name: Identity system planner
why: Plans a brand identity system in phases from client facts and every touchpoint, the same start as this kit's discovery step.

name: Brand mark system planner
why: Plans a mark and tests it at tiny and huge sizes, a second pass on the logo brief's small-size checks.

name: Logo strength tester
why: Scores logo ideas with a one-colour and small-size check, useful alongside the logo draft review prompt.

name: Brand guide builder
why: Turns a brand file into a printable guide and a values file, close to the brand guidelines book skill.

name: Visual system rules writer
why: Firm colour, type and grid rules that sit under the brand book's application pages.

name: Mood colour palette planner
why: A small palette with one job per colour, a starting point before the contrast pairing table.

name: Font pair shortlist maker
why: Three heading and body pairs with sizes, for clients with no brand fonts yet.

name: Icon set planner
why: Grid and style rules for an icon set before anyone draws, matching the icon set spec prompt.

name: Brand stylescape planner
why: Three mood board directions with photo, type and colour choices, for the discovery stage.

name: Store name tester
why: Tests a name before a logo or domain is bought, ahead of the first trade mark search.

name: Store rebrand planner
why: Decides whether to keep, tweak or change a name, the question behind any refresh.

name: Build a brand file and style guide from scratch
why: A guided run from nothing to a brand file and style guide, close to the new identity workflow.
